Name: Harvey Revised
Author: saltnburn
Description:
Nothing fancy here, folks. Just a simple wardrobe change for Harvey's sprites and portraits. Like many others, I was a little on the fence about him when I started the game, but then I realized it wasn't the mustache that was off-putting: It was the Jolly Green Pimp outfit. So I toned it down with a pullover over a button down and what's either a corduroy or flight jacket (depending on user preference). Jeans and sensible shoes complete it.  I don't think the citizens will complain if he's not in a suit and tie. (Especially considering the suit and tie he had.) He's still got a wide stance, but no more bowlegged posture.

I also changed his spring dance, exercise, and wedding outfits. You're welcome. Particularly when it comes to the wedding outfit (80's Prom Theme aside, why would you need to be SO formal for a wedding in a town of a few dozen people?)

Finally, I changed his glasses a bit, for the sprites, so he doesn't look quite so Revenge of the Nerds.

All digs at Harvey aside, he's by far my favorite eligible character, and I've been using the provided version for months: He was the very first thing I ever modded, and now the second thing I've shared.

Should be shipshape and ready to go. I hope you get as much enjoyment out of the change as I do.


2-8-22 I should've said this a looooonnnnng time ago, but for anyone who wants to update and/or edit, and share Harvey Revised, or Elliott Revised, please feel free to. That goes for sharing here on Nexusmods or anywhere else; You're very welcome to share your editions wherever you like. You can share a link to your editions here, if you want to (and of course you're not obligated to, if you'd rather not). Credit if you want to. Don't credit if you'd rather not. I'll see what I can do (hopefully) in the coming days to make them on par with the current game, but then I think the only sane thing to do with my track record is let them go to the community. 
If I don't respond to your questions, I can absolutely promise it's not because I'm intentionally ignoring you. I just take scatterbrained to the nth dimension, by not checking in more than every half a decade. On that note, be aware that it's entirely possible I may respond to something asked in 2022, in 2026. (It'll start with an apology for taking four years to reply.)
